_note: Curator-maintained markers per axis, per ADR-001. These are prompts for a human reviewer, not rules. They are assembled into the reviewer's brief and never evaluated automatically.

religion: A deity, symbol or scripture used as a product mascot or in a discount frame
A festival used as a sales hook without acknowledging its observance
A place of worship as set dressing for a commercial transaction
One tradition's practice shown as quaint, exotic or superstitious
caste: An occupation shown as inherited or as a marker of the family's standing
Domestic or manual labour shown without the worker as a person
Skin tone correlated with the role a character occupies
A surname or community name used to signal class
gender: Household work shown as belonging to one gender by default
A woman's competence framed through approval from a mother-in-law or husband
Body size, skin tone or age used as the setup for a joke
A man shown as incompetent at domestic tasks as the comic premise
region: An accent used as the punchline rather than as speech
A small town or village shown as backward against a metro
Northeastern, southern or eastern Indian features used as visual shorthand
One language treated as the default and others as local colour
political: National symbols, the flag or the armed forces used for a commercial claim
A position taken on a contested public question
A living political figure referenced, favourably or otherwise
A government scheme implied as endorsement
